data.name: Hazira
data.gender_notes: Hazira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is the embodiment of grace and blessings, loved and cherished by all. The name Hazira carries the meaning “Graceful, Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hazira usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman who is a source of inspiration and guidance, and is deeply connected to her faith.
data.etymology: Hazira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazira total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: حزيرة
in_arabic.meaning: حزيرة تعني الحديقة أو البستان في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: حزيرة هي اسم يعود إلى الأصول العربية، ويشير إلى الحديقة أو البستان الجميل. في اللغة العربية، الحزيرة تعني المكان الذي يجمع بين الجمال الطبيعي والهدوء. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصفي للجنات والحدائق التي وعد الله بها المؤمنين.

in_urdu.name: حزیرہ
in_urdu.meaning: حزیرہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت باغ یا بستان
in_urdu.long_meaning: حزیرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت باغ یا بستان۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے बीच میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس نام کی اہمیت اس کی جڑوں میں ہے جو العربية زبان سے ملتی ہیں، جہاں یہ محفوظ اور خوبصورت مقامات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हज़ीरा
in_hindi.meaning: हज़ीरा का अर्थ है सुंदर बगीचा या बाग

in_english.name: Hazira
in_english.meaning: Hazira means beautiful garden or orchard in English
in_english.long_meaning: Hazira is an Arabic name that originates from the word 'ḥazīrah', which means a beautiful garden or orchard. This name has a rich history in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quran as a description of the gardens and paradises promised to believers. The name Hazira symbolizes beauty, serenity, and spiritual growth.

This term is often used to describe a woman who possesses exceptional beauty, grace, kindness, and wisdom. She is a noble figure, admired by her community and loved by her family. The name "Hazira" carries an air of sophistication and elegance, reflecting the high regard that is given to women in Islamic traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, "Hazira" represents the divine feminine, embodying the grace and compassion of Allah in women. She is a reminder of the blessings that Allah bestows upon his creation, and the importance of cherishing and honoring every woman as a sacred gift from the Creator. The name "Hazira" also evokes the idea of being present and available to others, symbolizing a continuous source of love, comfort, and guidance.
